summary: Chartr is a desktop terminal and agent workspace; its current macOS build, 451 workspace tests and 3 isolated backend tests pass. Since v0.3.2, two styling changes reached main, while terminal naming and the Tabs left inset remain local. Native naming behavior and broader desktop coverage remain unverified.

findings.title: Terminal naming and the Tabs inset are uncommitted
findings.text: The working tree adds automatic/manual titles, configurable name lifetime, durable identity handling and a matching Tabs left gap.
findings.next: Verify terminal naming in an isolated native app.

findings.title: 2 styling commits are absent from v0.3.2
findings.text: Main adds the rounded workspace frame and smaller space headings; its macOS, Ubuntu, Arch and package jobs pass.
findings.next: Prepare a next-release checklist covering the committed and local changes.

findings.title: 2 feature descriptions retain outdated wording
findings.text: Settings names IBM Plex Sans instead of Geist, and lifecycle still calls Close All Sessions a dirty addition although v0.3.2 includes it.
findings.next: Correct these current-feature descriptions while preserving dated migration evidence.

bugs: No product bug reproduced by the executed checks. GitHub has no open issues or pull requests.
